approval: explicit user approval, recorded at plan Task 0

execution_plan.note: Execution document, not part of the frozen protocol. This SHA-1 pins the version reviewed at freeze.

reviewed_design_bytes.note: The exact bytes reviewed and approved. Differs from design.sha1 only by the Status block flip from 'DRAFT FOR REVIEW' to 'APPROVED - FROZEN'; no protocol content changed.

git.note: Design section 12 permits a dirty tree for pre-change records. Scientific run kinds require worktree_clean=true and are refused until the tree is intentionally resolved.

note: Freezing authorizes no implementation, generation, diagnostic, match, commit, or push. Every subsequent plan task requires separate explicit user authorization.
